name: SoulGen
summary: Prompt-driven AI image generator focused on anime and photoreal adult character creation with lookalike tags and canvas outpainting tools.
ranking_rationale: Approachable web UI for quick character image generation without managing local checkpoints; held back by credit paywalls and rigid likeness policies.

pricing.free_tier: Trial preview heavily blurred/watermarked until paid plan
pricing.notes: Check soulgen.net pricing page before checkout; pay attention to auto-renewal settings.

pros: No local GPU or ComfyUI workflow setup required
Handles both stylized anime and photorealistic presets cleanly
Includes simple canvas expand/outpaint and background edit sliders
cons: Free tier gates usable downloads behind subscription + credit top-ups
Far less customizable than local SDXL/Flux or Civitai LoRA workflows

facts.value: Cloud AI character image & anime generator
Tag-driven character prompts, outpainting, and anime/real modes
